title: Kasol Tosh
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Bonfire evenings in Kasol and Tosh
overview:
Two villages in the Parvati Valley in one weekend: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Kasol Tosh group trip leaves Delhi in the evening, with group trips every Friday. The group assembles at the pickup point, gets a short briefing from the trip leaders and travels overnight by Tempo Traveller to reach Kasol the next morning.

Day 1 covers the Kasol flea market, nearby cafes and the riverside trail to Chalal village, then dinner with a bonfire and light music. On Day 2 you drive to Barsheni, trek to Tosh, check in to a hotel or homestay and explore the village. Day 3 has Tosh Waterfall and cafe hopping, the trek down to Barsheni and a stop at Manikaran Gurdwara before the evening return to Delhi. Prices start at ₹7,699 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure to Kasol
itinerary.content:
Departure in the evening.
The group assembles at the pickup point.
Get a short briefing from the trip leader(s).
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Kasol sightseeing
itinerary.content:
Reach Kasol in the morning.
Check in at the stay, freshen up and relax for some time after the overnight journey.
Head out for Kasol sightseeing: the Kasol flea market and nearby cafes.
You can also explore Chalal village, a small riverside trail of 3 km both ways.
Return to the stay.
Dinner is served alongside a bonfire and light music.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Tosh
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Check out from the stay and leave for Barsheni (a 2-hour drive).
From Barsheni, trek to Tosh.
Reach Tosh and check in to the hotel or homestay.
Explore the village of Tosh and take in the views of Parvati Valley.
Enjoy a bonfire, dinner and an overnight stay at Tosh.

itinerary.title: Tosh, Manikaran and departure
itinerary.content:
After an early breakfast, check out and head out for sightseeing.
Visit Tosh Waterfall and go cafe hopping.
Trek down to Barsheni and head towards Kasol.
Visit Manikaran Gurdwara on the way.
Board the vehicle in the evening for the return journey to Delhi.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. You travel overnight and reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Kasol Tosh trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,699 per person on quad sharing, ₹8,199 on triple sharing and ₹8,699 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

1 night stay in Kasol and 1 night stay in Tosh, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, transfers by Tempo Traveller, all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary, the trek from Barsheni to Tosh, bonfire and light music, and a tour curator. Dinner on the journey from Delhi is not included.
On Day 2 you drive from Kasol to Barsheni, which takes about 2 hours, and then trek to Tosh. The itinerary lists it as a 6 km trek both ways. You trek back down to Barsheni on Day 3.
The first night is in Kasol and the second night is in a hotel or homestay at Tosh.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
